tools.description: Airdrop eligibility score for an address + calibrated expected value of the opportunity (sybil-rejection and token-decay adjusted) Price: $0.05 per call, USDC on Base via x402.

tools.name: token-check
tools.description: Pre-trade token verdict OK/CAUTION/AVOID/UNKNOWN: honeypot sell simulation, buy/sell tax, owner powers (mint/blacklist/balance change), DEX liquidity & pair age; every flag sourced (GoPlus + honeypot.is + DexScreener). Fails closed: no data -> UNKNOWN, never OK Price: $0.02 per call, USDC on Base vi

tools.name: transfer-route
tools.description: Cheapest open network to move a coin from exchange A to exchange B: withdraw/deposit open, fee, minimums, memo, ETA, congestion; same-ticker-different-contract traps flagged Price: $0.05 per call, USDC on Base via x402.

tools.name: wallet-status
tools.description: Is deposit/withdraw of a coin open right now, per network on bitget, gate, htx, kucoin + last-30-day notices from bitget, kucoin, okx (suspend/delist/migration) -> OPEN/PARTIAL/CAUTION Price: $0.02 per call, USDC on Base via x402.

tools.name: ticker-collision
tools.description: Same ticker = same token everywhere? Contract per chain on bitget, gate, htx, kucoin + price vs median on bitget, gate, htx, kucoin, mexc, okx -> CONSISTENT/DIVERGENT/COLLISION (anti-scam before deposit/arbitrage) Price: $0.05 per call, USDC on Base via x402.

tools.name: funding-snapshot
tools.description: Perp funding of a coin now on bitget, gate, kucoin, okx: rate, interval, annualized, mark/index basis where published, cross-venue spread. Market data only Price: $0.02 per call, USDC on Base via x402.

tools.name: leverage-calc
tools.description: Max safe leverage for a perp trade: liquidation >=1.5x beyond stop (never off), costs vs move, risk per trade, measured survival cap, exchange limit -> min with the binding constraint named Price: $0.05 per call, USDC on Base via x402.
